fact: Communication Technologies Minister Sofien Hemissi said his ministry has begun drafting legal and regulatory frameworks for responsible use of AI, protecting data and privacy.
system: legal and regulatory frameworks for responsible AI use

fact: The Rights and Freedoms Committee reviewed a 123-article draft organic law on personal data protection that, per its chairman, regulates the use of artificial intelligence and establishes the right not to be subject to a solely automated decision, with impact assessments for high-risk processing.
